description: Canonical 8-state definitions, visual properties, ARIA mapping, and justified exclusion contracts for ui-component-expert interactive components.

default.name: Default (Rest)
default.description: Baseline interactive state when component is at rest, enabled, and unselected.
visualRequirements: Baseline semantic background, text, and border tokens

hover.name: Hover
hover.description: Pointer device cursor positioned over the interactive boundary.
visualRequirements: Subtle brightness, elevation, or contrast transition
Cursor changed to pointer where appropriate

focus.name: Focus
focus.description: Keyboard or programmatic focus directed to the component element.
visualRequirements: High-contrast visible focus ring (minimum 2px solid with 3:1 contrast against background)
Offset from element edge (1-2px) to prevent clipping
focus.ergonomicStandard: WCAG 2.2 AA (2.4.7 focus visible), working toward AAA (2.4.13 focus appearance)

active.name: Active (Pressed)
active.description: Primary pointer button down or keyboard Enter/Space activation.
visualRequirements: Visual compression, darker shade, or depressed elevation

disabled.name: Disabled
disabled.description: Element is not operable, blocks click and key events, and is excluded from tab order.
visualRequirements: Reduced opacity (e.g. 50-60%) or muted semantic color

ariaAttributes.aria-disabled: Not required on native HTML elements when native disabled attribute is present; used for custom non-native focusable disabled elements

loading.name: Loading (Busy)
loading.description: Asynchronous operation pending; interaction temporarily inhibited with progress indication.
visualRequirements: Animated spinner or skeleton placeholder displayed
Original label preserved or replaced with loading status text

error.name: Error (Invalid)
error.description: Validation constraint failure on input, form, or interactive submission.
visualRequirements: Error token border and icon (e.g. status-error red)
Descriptive, human-readable error message rendered below element

ariaAttributes.aria-invalid: true (applied strictly to form input controls)
ariaAttributes.aria-describedby: Bound to error message container ID

selected.name: Selected
selected.description: Role-specific toggle, tab, radio, checkbox, or selectable item active/chosen state. (Note: success is an optional feedback state where applicable, not a replacement for selected).
visualRequirements: Accent background, indicator badge, checkmark, or high-contrast border

ariaAttributes.aria-selected: true (role-specific: tabs, listbox options, tree items)
ariaAttributes.aria-checked: true (role-specific: checkboxes, radio buttons, switch primitives)

exclusionRules.requirement: Any interactive control omitting one of the 8 canonical states MUST document an explicit non-empty reason string in its contract definition (NonApplicableState).
validReasons: NOT_A_TOGGLE: Single-action trigger (e.g. standard submit button) does not possess a persistent selected or toggle state.
STATIC_TRIGGER: Action cannot fail validation independently; error state handled at form container level.
INSTANT_EXECUTION: Synchronous action completes instantly without asynchronous loading state.
